institution: Jaypee University of Engineering and Technology
purpose: Starter location database for a JUET campus guide or navigation project.
important_data_notes: This is a research-based starter dataset, not a surveyed campus GIS map.
Coordinates are null because reliable individual building coordinates were not established from the available official sources. Do not use null coordinates as map pins.
Nearby-place links are tagged with evidence and notes. Some are official relationships; some describe a shared route or require on-campus confirmation.
LT-1 is explicitly identified by JUET as being in Ramanujan Bhavan.

The official tour lists LT-2, LT-3, LT-4 and LT-5 individually, but the public index does not specify each theatre's Bhawan. They are grouped here as one provisional search target and should be split into separate map points after field verification.

Registrar Office, VC Office, Board Room and Chancellor Office are grouped as one administrative destination for this starter dataset; their exact building-level arrangement should be verified on campus.

sources.age_note: Older university report; use for broad campus relationships and re-check current naming/layout on site.

places.name: Main Gate
places.description: The main campus entrance used by students, visitors and vehicles to enter JUET.
places.where_to_find_it: At the main entry to the JUET campus. Use it as the starting point for the internal campus road.
places.nearby_notes: JUET's virtual-tour index describes a main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel, with the Tuck Shop, Cafeteria and a pathway to the Mess along that corridor. This is a shared-route description, not a claim that all facilities are directly beside the gate.

places.name: Nehru Plaza
places.description: A central campus reference point that is useful for orientation and meeting other students.
places.where_to_find_it: Identified as the campus Centre Point in JUET's official virtual tour.
places.nearby_notes: JUET's 2020-21 AQAR describes the Multipurpose Hall, Sports Ground and open lawn as being near Nehru Plaza. Treat this as a broad nearby relationship; exact walking distances are not published.

places.name: Academic Block Area
places.description: The main teaching area containing academic buildings, lecture theatres, classrooms, laboratories and departments.
places.where_to_find_it: JUET's virtual tour includes a viewpoint at the front of every Academic Block and a viewpoint at the centre of the Academic Block.
places.nearby_notes: LT-1 is documented in Ramanujan Bhavan; LRC is documented in Vishvesvaraya Bhawan. JUET's older AQAR names Ramanujan Bhawan, Raman Bhawan and Vishvesvaraya Bhawan as its three academic blocks.

places.name: LT-1
places.description: A lecture theatre used for academic sessions and examinations. JUET's PGET-2025 instructions explicitly name it as an examination venue.
places.where_to_find_it: Inside Ramanujan Bhavan, in the academic block area.
places.nearby_notes: The exact entrance, floor and closest neighbouring room are not given in the public source; confirm these on site.

places.name: Lecture Theatres LT-2 to LT-5
places.description: A provisional search group for four lecture-theatre destinations. JUET's virtual-tour index lists LT-2, LT-3, LT-4 and LT-5 as named viewpoints.
places.building_or_area: Academic / theatre area; individual Bhawan assignments not confirmed
places.where_to_find_it: Look in the academic/theatre area and follow the individual LT labels. This record intentionally groups the four names until their separate physical positions are captured.
places.nearby_notes: Do not place all four labels at one coordinate. Split this record into four records once each theatre entrance is confirmed.

places.name: Learning Resource Centre (LRC)
places.description: The university library and learning resource centre, with books, journals, digital resources and computer access. The 2026 brochure says it can accommodate about 250 users.
places.where_to_find_it: Inside Vishvesvaraya Bhawan, one of JUET's academic buildings.
places.nearby_notes: The official 2026 brochure confirms the building name. Exact floor and nearest entrance should be confirmed on site.

places.name: Administrative Offices
places.description: Administrative destination covering the Registrar Office and other senior university offices. The virtual tour separately lists Registrar Office, VC Office, Board Room and Chancellor Office.
places.building_or_area: Administrative area; exact block not confirmed
places.where_to_find_it: Use the Registrar Office as the primary search term. JUET's tour also marks a viewpoint at the ramp in front of the Registrar Office.
sub_location_names: Ramp viewpoint in front of Registrar Office
places.nearby_notes: The public tour index does not specify the exact building relationship or walking distance between these offices. Verify whether they share a block before assigning one pin.

places.name: Tagore Hall / Multipurpose Hall (MPH)
places.description: A large indoor hall used for university events, cultural programmes, presentations and indoor sports. JUET identifies the facility as Tagore Hall / Multipurpose Hall.
places.where_to_find_it: Near Nehru Plaza, according to JUET's 2020-21 AQAR; the official virtual tour labels it as MPH.
places.nearby_notes: The nearby relationship is supported by the older university AQAR. Exact entrance orientation and distance need on-site verification.

places.name: Sports Ground
places.description: Outdoor sports area for activities such as football, cricket and other field/court sports. JUET's virtual tour lists a separate Sports Ground viewpoint.
places.where_to_find_it: Near Nehru Plaza, according to JUET's 2020-21 AQAR.
places.nearby_notes: The nearby relationship is supported by the older university AQAR. The exact sports-field entrance and individual court locations need field verification.

places.name: Shopping Centre / Tuck Shops / Cafeteria
places.description: A campus convenience cluster that includes two tuck shops, a multipurpose shop, grocery, bakery, ice-cream shop and cafeteria, according to JUET's facilities page.
places.building_or_area: Main-road corridor in front of the Main Entry and hostel
places.where_to_find_it: Use the main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel. JUET's virtual tour specifically associates this corridor with the Tuck Shop and Cafeteria.
places.nearby_notes: The tour describes a shared main-road corridor and a pathway to the Mess; it does not prove that every shop is directly beside the gate or Mess. Verify the exact shop-by-shop layout on site.

places.name: Annapurna Student Mess
places.description: JUET's student dining facility. The university states that separate Annapurna messes are established for boys and girls, serving students and employees.
places.building_or_area: Mess complex; approach via the main-road pathway
places.where_to_find_it: Follow the pathway to the Mess mentioned in JUET's virtual-tour description of the main road in front of the Main Entry and hostel.
places.nearby_notes: The virtual-tour index confirms a pathway to the Mess from the main-road corridor. The precise position of the boys' and girls' dining entrances should be verified separately.

places.name: Hostel Area (Boys' and Girls' Hostels)
places.description: Student residential area with separate boys' and girls' hostel facilities. JUET's hostel page lists 21 boys' hostel blocks and a separate girls' hostel; the virtual tour includes Boys Hostel, Girls Hostel and a rear view of Hostel 6.
places.building_or_area: Hostel-side campus road and residential clusters
places.where_to_find_it: JUET's virtual tour identifies the main road in front of the hostel and separate viewpoints for Boys Hostel and Girls Hostel.
places.nearby_notes: The tour places the Tuck Shop, Cafeteria and Mess pathway on the main-road corridor in front of the Main Entry and hostel. Confirm the exact route to each hostel block and the girls' hostel separately.
